instruction: In 154_3.pptx, apply underline formatting to the slide title 'GPT'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly opens the saved pptx file and reads the title shape's text runs, checking run.font.underline for each run.
Metric correctly returns 1.0 only when all_underlined is True, matching the instruction requirement of applying underline to the title.
Postconfig saves the file via Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring fresh file state is read.
Edge cases handled: empty runs_info returns False (bool([]) == False), and None underline values (inherited) correctly fail the check via 'is True'.
Instruction coverage is complete: instruction only requires underline on the title 'GPT', and the evaluator checks exactly that.
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric ignores the 'expected' param and hardcodes the check logic, which is valid for this simple boolean requirement.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider using the title placeholder format (shape.placeholder_format.idx == 0) instead of slide.shapes[0] to more robustly identify the title shape, in case the shape order differs from the typical layout.
